assets.name: duel-badge
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Bounty Breakers slot game feature symbol, a standalone raster game loot icon.
Primary request: DUEL BADGE, represented only by crossed chunky science-fiction pulse revolvers: one orange weapon and one cyan weapon crossed on a striking gunmetal badge backing, with a small red targeting gem at the center. NO LETTERS OR TEXT ANYWHERE.
Style/medium: polished cel-shaded 3D video-game loot illustration with very thick confident black ink outlines, angular beveled metal panels, slightly distressed edges, hard graphic shadows, white and orange edge highlights, saturated cyan emissive accents. Match the visual language of a futuristic bounty-hunter slot game with chunky silhouettes and premium metallic objects. Not pixel art, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered cohesive symbol on a square 1024x1024 canvas. All parts entirely in frame with about 10 percent breathing room on each edge; subject occupies about 80 percent of the canvas. Clear symmetrical crossed weapon silhouette that remains instantly readable at 70px. Avoid fussy microdetails.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, clean cutout with no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no scene or border. If transparency is not supported, use a perfectly uniform near-black #0b1520 background.
Color palette: rich orange and bright cyan weapons; charcoal gunmetal badge; small vivid red targeting gem; crisp pale metal highlights.
Constraints: original design without franchise marks. No skull needed. No letters VS, no letters, numbers, wording, captions, typography, logos, watermark, UI, or additional symbols. The entire image must be just the single duel badge object.
